text: No, this property was not deforested in 2020. The 67.7 ha of tree loss reported in 2020 occurred *before* the baseline date of December 31, 2020, as confirmed by the Hansen GFC dataset. The JRC 2020 reference data also shows no forest cover remaining on the asset by 2020 (0.0 ha), meaning the loss had already happened prior to the claim period. Deforestation would require tree loss *during* the claim interval, but the evidence shows the trees were already gone by the baseline. The small loss in 2021 (0.4 ha) was also too minor to qualify as an event.
